scope.reason: The sentence introducing the ruling (On those grounds, THE COURT hereby rules:) loses the holding role where the Court sets it on several lines: the General Court's unmarked opening row and the oldest layout's bare paragraphs. Derive the case number from every case-law CELEX document form by its court letter, so a Civil Service Tribunal order (62013FO0060) reads F-60/13 instead of the raw CELEX; the case number has no separate feature storage. A bare number after a dash in the keyword chain closes a range inside the keyword before it instead of standing as a keyword of its own; keywords have no separate feature storage. Retain the publisher's excluded notice fields in the stored notice instead of naming them as exclusions. Block text folds letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, which also reads a short spaced word beside a spaced word and treats a no-break space as a word gap; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Re-read stored CJEU documents: a title set over several lines (an opinion's author and delivery line, a judgment's chamber and date) is one decision-title heading, and each footnote-list entry is a footnote note keyed by its anchor; headings and notes have no separate feature storage. Read the converter's table of contents after the signatures (coj-NTOCn entries) as publisher notes instead of continuing the operative part; roles have no separate feature storage. Re-derive stored citations with rule kinds, polarity evidence windows and cited parts; the canonical AST and publisher metadata do not change.
